verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's own pages document online filing for formation and annual reports. The annual-report flow is entered by referring to the state's notice or searching records by name, and the documented card payment options sit alongside an optional prepaid E-File Account rather than requiring one. Together these imply, but never state, a keyless identifier-based entry path without prior account creation. missing for 10: explicit statement that no account or login is needed to start online formation filing, explicit document/file-number entry instructions for the core founder (formation) flow, hands-on or independent confirmation of the keyless path.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: Refer to your notice or search our records by name.
Online Payment Options: Credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express or Discover). Debit card (Visa or MasterCard logo). Prepaid Sunbiz E-File Account.
Form a Limited Liability Company — Online Filing: Articles of Organization
